t.E999.agn: In 2019 EFSA set the acceptable daily intake (ADI) at 3 mg saponins/kg body weight (replacing the SCF's 1978 value of 5 mg dried extract/kg) and stated that estimated exposure did not exceed this limit in any age group. Changes in the weight of digestive organs have been reported in animal studies, but these were not accompanied by consistent tissue changes.
t.E999.body: Intact saponins are poorly absorbed from the gut and are broken down in the digestive tract; the remaining portion is also absorbed to a limited extent.
t.E999.prod: Obtained by extraction from the bark of the quillaia tree.
t.E999.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI 3 mg saponins/kg body weight/day, exposure does not exceed the ADI.
t.E999.summary: An extract obtained from the bark of the quillaia tree. Creates foam in drinks.
t.E999.what: A saponin-containing extract obtained from the bark of the quillaia tree; used as a foaming agent and emulsifier.
